mechanism.mechanism_of_action: Next-generation oral selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD) and complete ER antagonist that degrades ERα and blocks estrogen signaling, overcoming ESR1 mutations

clinical.indications: HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer (1st-line and 2nd-line settings)

market.market_position: First next-gen oral SERD with consistent PFS benefit, potential blockbuster [uncertain]
